description: Seznam kategoriziranih občinskih cest v občini Kočevje is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA KOČEVJE. List of categorized municipal roads in the municipality of Kočevje. Municipal roads are categorized into local roads and public paths. Coverage: OBČINA KOČEVJE. The portal shows the English title as "List of categorized municipal roads in the municipality of Kočevje" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA KOČEVJE. Its keywords include javne poti, kategorizacija cest, ceste, zbirne krajevne ceste, lokalne ceste, krajevne ceste. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
